title: Open Video Toolbox External AI Chapters
description: Workflow-level schema for chapter lists authored by an external AI or a human. This is not yet a formal CLI command contract.

input.description: Path to the local source media, resolved by the workflow owner.

text.description: Optional transcript, subtitle, or text artifact used to author the chapters.

origin.description: Optional human-readable provenance, such as local file, YouTube URL, or meeting recording source.

notes.description: Optional workflow note for humans and external AI agents. OVT does not depend on this field for media decisions.

id.description: Stable id suitable for directory names and batch item ids.

summary.description: External AI or human summary. OVT should not rely on this for deterministic editing decisions.

selected.description: Optional workflow flag for human/AI selection. Consumers may ignore unselected chapters.
